topic: Stop ChatGPT from agreeing with everything you say: set a custom instruction so it gives honest, critical feedback instead of flattery (sycophancy fix)

Keep your real face when editing photos in ChatGPT: upload a clear, well-lit reference photo, tell it to preserve your exact facial features and identity, change only the background, clothes or lighting, and edit one thing at a time instead of regenerating the whole image

Find jobs LinkedIn doesn't show you by using Google site: searches on the Lever, Ashby and Greenhouse career boards (e.g. site:jobs.lever.co "job title" remote), then have an AI assistant summarize new postings each morning

See what ChatGPT has stored about you and take control of it. Open Settings > Personalization > Memory > Manage to review and delete memories, turn memory off, or use Temporary Chat. Then run the 3 self-analysis prompts that make it reflect on your patterns and blind spots.
ChatGPT isn't the best AI for every job. Show which free AI tool to use for research, long writing, coding and content, and a quick test to compare them on the same prompt.
